sentences.text: 2 2. This bunch of cases are related to village Kesur and Maulani, Tahsil & District Dhar.
The land in question has been acquired for construction of Maulani Taalab (Pond) under the Irrigation Scheme.

3. The issue regarding grant of compensation to the land-owners of villages - Kesur and Maulani, Tahsil and District Dhar (MP) in lieu of land acquired for public purpose in respect of construction of Maulani Taalabh (Pond) under the Irrigation Scheme at Maulani, Tahsil and District Dhar, has been decided on 07.07.2017 by this Court in First Appeal No.971/2014.

The State of Madhya Pradesh and another v.
Mangu s/o Moti Banjara, by which appeal of the landowners has been allowed in part.
4.
